source_url.description: Exactly the input URL, character for character.

title.description: Page title (title tag, og:title, or first h1). Required and non-empty: a run without a title must fail.

description.description: meta description or og:description; null if the page has none.

author.description: meta author, byline, or rel=author text; null if absent.

published_date.description: Publication date normalized to YYYY-MM-DD; null if absent or not confidently normalizable.

headings.description: Text of h1/h2/h3 elements in document order, tags stripped; empty array if none.
